data.content_ref: inline:The claim labels the relation a 'contradiction,' but the content itself states both methods reach 252 (234+18 correction via enumeration versus inclusion-exclusion). Reaching the same result is equivalence/compatibility, not contradiction; the 'refuted if' clause tries to flip this by saying the methods would be equivalent if the 18-point correction were unnecessary, but the correction is presented as necessary, so the named relation kind is internally inconsistent with the evidence.
